objective: Establish exactly how Codex's own auto-review works, from the openai/codex source, so HolyAgent's Codex provider can reproduce it under Pi.
scope: Maintainer (verbatim): "the codex-auto-review should work similarly to how codex's work". Previous findings: /home/user/holyagent/.git/holyagent/reports/assignment-0mw969b0u-kquh.md (pi-codex-guardian calls model codex-auto-review at chatgpt.com/backend-api/codex/responses, rule-based, no defaults) and assignment-0mw9679bz-h35s.md (Codex docs: approvals_reviewer = "auto_review" with approval_policy = "on-request").

From github.com/openai/codex (the Rust codex-rs tree at a recent release tag; name the tag) and its docs (learn.chatgpt.com/docs/sandboxing/auto-review and the config reference), with file and symbol or URL: (1) what triggers a review: which tool calls or sandbox escalations become approval requests under on-request (commands needing escalated permissions, writes outside the workspace, network access, apply_patch outside writable roots, MCP tool calls), and what runs without one; (2) the reviewer request: model id, endpoint, prompt or policy text source, what context is sent (transcript slice, the pending action, cwd, sandbox policy), output schema, reasoning effort, timeouts; (3) the decision handling: allow, deny, deny with feedback to the model, failure, timeout, retries, and whether a denied action is reported back to the model and how; (4) any escalation to the human (when the reviewer is unsure) and any per-session memory of decisions; (5) what of this depends on Codex's sandbox, and what a host without a sandbox (Pi) would need to emulate (deciding which commands count as needing escalation).
Then state how pi-codex-guardian differs from that, and what HolyAgent would need to build to match Codex.
constraints: Read-only: change no files, make no git writes, write nothing under .git/ or .holyagent/.
Never run pi or Codex, or make a live model or OpenAI request.

criteria.text: Triggers, request, decision handling and escalation are each stated from Codex source or docs with references
What a sandbox-less host must emulate and how pi-codex-guardian differs are stated
